device.description: 16-bit 50-250 kSPS differential-input micropower SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: adc161s626.pdf (SNAS468D) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.7 timing requirements (Figure 1), p.16-17 serial digital interface and data output (two's complement), p.18 Figure 41

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC: VA 4.5-5.5 V, VIO 2.7-5.5 V, SCLK 1-5 MHz), p.7 (timing: tDA 41 ns max, tDIS 30 ns max, tEN 70 ns max after the 2nd SCLK fall; Figure 1), p.16-17 (frame: DOUT Z for the 1st SCLK fall, leading 0 on the 2nd, D15..D0 on the 3rd-18th falling edges; two's complement)
notModeled: analog input and reference (the result is always the 0 V code 0x0000, two's complement)
conversion clocked by SCLK during the first 17 periods after CS falls (not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once); acquisition after the 18th falling edge
CS raised before the 18th SCLK falling edge aborts the conversion (the model just ends the frame)
tEN (70 ns max) is measured from the 2nd SCLK falling edge, not CS; the first frame bit is Z so tValid is 0
SCLK frequency limits (1-5 MHz) and the minimum acquisition time
